# mergewf_group (Resource)

Manages a Workforce group. Import using its group ID. Manage API-created groups separately from groups owned by an identity provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mergewf_group" "example" {
  name = "Engineering"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) API field `name`. Minimum length: 1. Maximum length: 200.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource identity. See the resource description for its import format.
- `result_json` (String) Complete API response encoded as JSON. Use jsondecode to access additional response fields. Stored in Terraform state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mergewf_group.example RESOURCE_ID
```
